task.title: Establish the authoritative supervisor v2 specification and delta task store

scope.owned_layer: Authoritative task-state V2 persistence: compact current head, append-only state deltas, V1 archive migration and offline integrity verification, task-store architecture specification, and runtime caller telemetry migration.
scope.not_changing: Supervisor scheduling policy, task lifecycle policy, fleet routing, provider policy, live configuration, canonical live state, service processes, or deployment.

architecture.write_order: validate head and tail -> append/fsync delta -> atomically replace/fsync head
architecture.recovery: replay only the V2 delta tail after head.delta_offset; reject incomplete or corrupt tails
architecture.archive: V1 bytes are moved once to a read-only sibling archive with byte length, final sequence, journal SHA-256 and projected-state SHA-256 bound into V2 genesis/head identity
architecture.hot_path: No V1 archive read, V1 replay, mmap, prefix hash, checkpoint sidecar, or forced full replay is available to normal load or mutation paths.
architecture.offline_only: verify_full_chain() and scripts/verify_task_state_store.py validate every V2 delta and frozen V1 archive.

removed_hot_path: V1 full-board state on every event
full-journal mmap, hash, replay, and checkpoint cache
full-journal append readback and automatic V1 fallback
deletion_and_caller_report.caller_boundary: All remaining production callers use load_snapshot(), snapshot_transaction(), or append_state_commit(); load_events() and project_latest_state() are offline audit compatibility readers only.

acceptance_evidence.delta_not_full_state: A 1,200-task board status change serializes one tasks[index].status set delta and no persisted state field.
acceptance_evidence.constant_hot_read_cost: Synthetic multi-megabyte V1 archive migration test performs repeated load_snapshot calls with archive parsing patched to fail; every hot read succeeds.
failure_boundaries: stale expected sequence/head CAS is rejected
nonterminal task loss is rejected before append
crash after fsynced delta and before head replacement recovers exactly the tail
tampered frozen archive fails offline verification
nonempty V1 journal with no V2 head fails migration-required instead of falling back

verification.command: python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/rewrite/task_state_store.py scripts/verify_task_state_store.py scripts/migrate_task_state_store_v2.py scripts/ai_status.py scripts/dispatch_twelve_loop_gap_2026_07_26.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py && git diff --check

known_non_task_failure.reason: The unmodified origin/dev task card for L12-SIGNOFF-001 names owner Codex while the unmodified origin/dev catalog names owner Claude. This task does not own either legacy catalog/card surface.

rollout.source_delivery: Merge the reviewed task PR into dev. A separately governed runtime promotion performs the migration dry-run, migration, offline verification, and V2 canary.
rollout.rollback: Stop writers, preserve V2 head/deltas/manifest/archive, verify them offline, and use an explicit separately named V1 recovery journal only if an authorized older-binary rollback is required. No automatic V1 fallback exists.

review.protocol: Review this committed manifest, all changed paths, and the exact PR head. Bind this same review_file through the governed approve command; any changed PR head requires a new independent review.
